# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby was a handsome young woman with a plump, showy figure, long yellow hair, large bright-blue eyes, and a brilliant complexion. In her youth she flaunted a striking, earthy beauty, though during her illness she became very thin, delicate, and hectically flush. Following her death, her white-clad form was remembered as extraordinarily lovely.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P31](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0031)_

## Personality

Cheerful, good-tempered, and merry, Ruby frankly enjoyed life's pleasantries and laughed a great deal. She was deeply sentimental in her youth and prone to hysterical crying during dramatic events. As she grew older, she became preoccupied with young men, romance, and accumulating numerous suitors.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

## History

Ruby grew up in Avonlea among a large family of sisters. As a child, she attended Avonlea school alongside Anne Shirley and Diana Barry, participating in recitations, concerts, and their private Story Club. After preparing for the Entrance examinations, she attended Queen's Academy to earn a teaching certificate. Upon graduating, she took over the Carmody schoolhouse and spent her leisure time flirting with numerous local admirers. She was rumored to be courted by the Spencervale schoolteacher and received proposals from suitors like Nelson Atkins, whom she rejected after learning his declaration came straight from an etiquette guide. Eventually, she contracted galloping consumption during the winter and stopped teaching, though she maintained that she was getting better and planned to teach at White Sands. She died peacefully in her sleep at home shortly before Jane Andrews departed for the West.
